title: 중소기업인력지원 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00002:20130323:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Small and Medium Business Administration and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 2, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) and (2) Omitted.
(3) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Support for Human Resources of Small and Medium Enterprises shall be amended as follows:
In the portions of Articles 2 and 3 other than their respective subparagraphs, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy" shall in each case be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy".
(4) through (7) Omitted.
